facts.text: Caroline shared her personal struggles in the past and felt she could make a difference by offering support to others.

evidence.quote: It reminded me of my own struggles in the past and how I felt alone. I was glad I could share my story and offer them support - it felt like I could make a difference.
I felt fulfilled guiding and supporting them. I even got to let them know they're not alone by sharing my story.

facts.text: Caroline plans to continue volunteering at the youth center and has made strong connections with people there.

evidence.quote: I'm definitely carrying on volunteering at the youth center. It's an important part of my life and I've made strong connections with people there.

facts.text: Caroline is organizing a talent show for the youth center's participants, which she is looking forward to.

evidence.quote: We're putting together a talent show for the kids next month. I'm looking forward to seeing how much fun everyone has and how proud they'll feel of their talents!
